item.title: 9 dead as jet nosedives and erupts into fireball near busy roadway in South Florida
item.description: U.S. Transportation Secretary Duffy says all nine people died aboard a business jet that crashed into a Florida neighborhood. The aircraft departed from Austin, Texas, and was headed to the Bahamas.

item.title: Democrats are running on affordability. Are voters buying it?
item.description: Republicans started the year believing tax cuts would benefit them in the midterms. Instead other affordability issues are driving voters to Democrats.

item.title: Willie the pony treats hospital patients with medicine for the soul
item.description: Sometimes hospitals invite special guests to come visit patients in an effort to boost spirits. One "mane" attraction at an Ohio hospital is Willie Nelson- the pony.

item.title: The midterms will test the nation's political direction and confidence
item.description: At least some portion of the nation is likely to have its political confidence — and perhaps even its sense of security — tested in the days and weeks ahead. That test could also continue for some time to come.

item.title: New York City Marathon: Sweden's Almgren and Kenya's Chepkirui win as 60,000 take part
item.description: Andreas Almgren of Sweden won the men's race of the New York City Marathon in his debut in the event while Sheila Chepkirui of Kenya won the women's race on Sunday for the second time.

item.description: High prices are straining budgets for both a small business owner and a single mom in a rural part of Va.'s 1st Congressional district. They explain how they're handling the economic stress of these times.

item.title: 'Grasping at straws': Judge dismisses Trump suit against Wall Street Journal over Epstein letter
item.description: Saying the president was "grasping at straws," a federal judge on Saturday threw out Donald Trump's $10 billion lawsuit against The Wall Street Journal and media mogul Rupert Murdoch over a story reporting on his ties to Jeffrey Epstein.

item.title: Devastating storms continue to hit Southwest 'Four Corners' region
item.description: Communities in the Southwest are bracing for more flooding this weekend. This follows weeks of devastating storms that have pummeled parts of the region.
